import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def solve():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    
    painters = []
    index = 2
    for _ in range(q):
        l = int(data[index]) - 1
        r = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
        painters.append((l, r))
        index += 2

    # Initial painting coverage with all painters
    coverage = [0] * n
    for l, r in painters:
        for i in range(l, r + 1):
            coverage[i] += 1

    # Calculate total painted sections with all painters
    total_painted = sum(1 for x in coverage if x > 0)

    # Calculate contribution and overlap of each painter
    contribution = []
    for i, (l, r) in enumerate(painters):
        single_painter_coverage = sum(1 for j in range(l, r + 1) if coverage[j] == 1)
        contribution.append(single_painter_coverage)

    # Try removing two painters to maximize the painted sections
    max_painted = 0
    for i in range(q):
        for j in range(i + 1, q):
            # Calculate painted sections if we remove painter i and j
            painted_if_removed = total_painted
            painted_if_removed -= contribution[i]
            painted_if_removed -= contribution[j]
            max_painted = max(max_painted, painted_if_removed)

    print(max_painted)

solve()
